title: UrduBench: An Urdu Reasoning Benchmark using Contextually Ensembled Translations with Human-in-the-Loop
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on reasoning tasks such as mathematics (MGSM, MATH-500), common sense (CommonSenseQA), and factual knowledge (OpenBookQA) translated into Urdu. It does not include benchmarks or evaluations specifically related to religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
